title: LLM Request Traces
description: Per-request view over the LLM body indices. request_id joins the request doc (llm-request-body-*) with the response doc (llm-response-body-*) — one request can span minutes of streaming, so the slowest-request table is keyed on request_time. Request vs response rates expose in-flight/lost requests (the gap). Use the LLM Body Logs (Discover) search to open an individual request_id and read its full request/response payloads. Instance = upstream_addr ip:port (llama-server 8001-8004 behind app.llm.lan).
